note: schedule of 10 doses, irregular times and varying amounts, unsorted records, a zero dose, infusions that overlap

quantities.conc: concentration of the central compartment at the time t of the origin shared by the dose times: the sum of the single-dose functions of every dose (0 before the first dose; a bolus exactly at its dose time counts)
quantities.auc: sum of the single-dose areas, each from its own dose time (not from its lag), to the time
quantities.scalar: auc_inf = sum of the doses / CL (the sum of the single-dose areas to infinity, MOD-MD-01)

method.closed_form: plain sum of the single-dose closed forms of the model (explicit sums of exponentials, MOD-IVB-01, MOD-IVI-01, MOD-AB1-01, MOD-AB0-01, MOD-2C-07..12, the lag as a delay), 256-bit arithmetic (Rmpfr), rounded once to double; areas are the exact integrals of the terms; steady state is the sum over j = 0..N with the tail bounded below 2^-70 of the smallest value; the geometric-series forms of MOD-MD-03..06 and 10 give no value and are checked against the sums in the script (agreement 2^-60)
cross_checks: adaptive ODE solver (deSolve lsoda, rtol 1e-12) with the doses as events and a state for the AUC
steady state: periodic solution of the linear system (fixed point of the one-period map) and, up to 3000 doses, a long train of dosing events
